run_PDControllerExplicitMultiDof_compute: run PDControllerExplicitMultiDof computePD to calculate torque for multi-DOF joints using explicit PD control
run_PDControllerStable_computePD: run PDControllerStable computePD to calculate torque for joints using a numerically stable PD control approach
run_setJointMotorControl2_PD_CONTROL: run setJointMotorControl2 with PD_CONTROL mode to control a joint using position and velocity gains
run_setJointMotorControlMultiDof_TORQUE_: run setJointMotorControlMultiDof with TORQUE_CONTROL to apply computed torque values to multi-DOF joints
run_loadPlugin_pdControlPlugin: run loadPlugin to load the pdControlPlugin enabling native PD_CONTROL mode for joint motor control
